headline: H200 index jumps +17% to $6.31 over 7 days while B200 eases -6% to $7.99.
bullets: H200 market index rose +17% to $6.31 over the 7-day window, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $3.59 versus a hyperscaler median of $10.30.
B200 fell -6% to a $7.99 index and remains the best price-performance GPU at $3.55 per PFLOP-hour, with RunPod Community Cloud lowest at $5.98.
H100 SXM, MI300X, A100 80GB SXM and L40S were flat at +0%, with indexes of $4.32, $4.73, $2.70 and $1.50 respectively.
H100 SXM carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +162% ($10.68 hyperscaler vs $4.07 neocloud), while B200 has the narrowest at +77%.
A100 80GB SXM is the least efficient at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour despite a Vast.ai floor of $1.09.
watch: Whether the H200 run-up continues, narrowing its gap to the B200 index of $7.99 and further undercutting H200 value at $6.38 per PFLOP-hour.
